title: QUIZ - 50
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.concept: Multi-Step Word Problem Translation
questions.learningObjective: Translate a word problem requiring combined like terms into an equation and solve it
questions.question: A number t is such that 5 times the number, added to the number itself, gives 126. Write and solve an equation to find t.
questions.explanation: "5 times the number, added to the number itself" gives 5t + t = (5+1)t = 126. So t = 126/6 = 21.
questions.hint: Combine the like terms in the verbal statement into a single coefficient before solving.

questions.concept: Translating Word Problems into One-Variable Equations
questions.learningObjective: Translate a verbal statement into a linear equation
questions.question: 10 times a number y, decreased by 19, is 17. Write an equation representing this statement.
questions.explanation: "10 times a number" is 10y. "Decreased by 19" gives 10y - 19. Setting this equal to 17 gives 10y - 19 = 17.
questions.hint: Translate the phrase into an expression first, then set it equal to the given result.

questions.concept: Solving Translated Word Problem Equations
questions.learningObjective: Translate a word problem into an equation and solve it for the unknown
questions.question: A gardener plants 3 rows of m flowers each, plus 16 extra flowers in pots, for a total of 28 flowers. How many flowers are in each row?
questions.explanation: The equation is 3m + 16 = 28. Subtracting 16: 3m = 12. Dividing by 3: m = 4.
questions.hint: Set up an equation from the scenario, then solve it using inverse operations.
